prompt_latex: Evaluate the definite integral $\int_{0}^{1} x e^{x} dx$ using integration by parts.
explanation_latex: Using $\int u dv = uv - \int v du$ with $u = x, dv = e^x dx$: $[x e^x]_0^1 - \int_0^1 e^x dx = e - (e - 1) = 1$.

explanation_latex: A process is thermodynamically spontaneous at constant temperature and pressure when the Gibbs free energy change $\Delta G < 0$.
